jobs.title: Public Health & Education Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------


The Public Health \& Education Program Manager leads the strategy, implementation, growth, and continuous improvement of national public health education and training initiatives. This position manages programs across the full lifecycle—from planning and curriculum development through implementation, evaluation, partnership development, scaling, and long\-term sustainability. Reporting to the Senior Director, Training \& Education, the Program Manager collaborates with cross\-functional teams, subject matter experts, instructors, affiliates, and external partners to deliver high\-quality educational programs that advance public health priorities and improve outcomes. This role combines strategic program leadership with hands\-on execution, including program delivery, curriculum development, Train\-the\-Trainer initiatives, conference and event management, stakeholder engagement, marketing support, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

**Experience \& Duties**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of progressively responsible program management experience.
* Experience managing programs from strategy and planning through implementation and ongoing operations.
* Experience delivering instructor\-led training and Train\-the\-Trainer programs.
* Strong project management, stakeholder engagement, communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a collaborative environment.
**Program Strategy and Lifecycle Management**
---------------------------------------------

* Develop and implement strategies for national public health education and training programs aligned with organizational priorities and community needs.
* Translate strategic priorities into actionable project plans, timelines, deliverables, resource requirements, and measurable success metrics.
* Manage assigned programs through the full lifecycle, ensuring quality, efficiency, sustainability, and continuous improvement.
**Program Operations and Implementation**
-----------------------------------------

* Manage the day\-to\-day operations and successful delivery of assigned programs.
* Coordinate timelines, logistics, meeting schedules, program inboxes, shared resources, and deliverables across internal and external stakeholders.
* Serve as an instructor, facilitator, and presenter for educational programs, webinars, and training sessions as needed.
**Education, Training, and Curriculum**
---------------------------------------

* Lead the planning, coordination, facilitation, and evaluation of instructor\-led education programs, including seizure first aid and Train\-the\-Trainer initiatives.
* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve curricula and learning materials in partnership with subject matter experts.
**Program Growth and Sustainability**
-------------------------------------

* Develop strategies to expand program reach, participant engagement, trainer capacity, and long\-term impact.
* Partner with leadership to support grant deliverables, budget tracking, resource planning, conference and event management, marketing efforts, and sustainability initiatives.
**Partnerships and Stakeholder Engagement**
-------------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain strategic relationships with affiliates, community organizations, healthcare organizations, educational institutions, professional associations, funders, and other partners.
* Identify and cultivate partnerships that strengthen program development, delivery, and sustainability.
**Evaluation and Continuous Improvement**
-----------------------------------------

* Establish, monitor, and report on program goals, objectives, key performance indicators, and outcomes.
* Collect and analyze participation data, learner feedback, and stakeholder input to evaluate effectiveness and inform continuous improvement, research, abstracts, and publications.
**Expected Deliverables**
-------------------------

* Execute national public health education and seizure first aid program strategies.
* Deliver high\-quality instructor\-led training and oversee day\-to\-day program operations.
* Increase participation, trainer capacity, partner engagement, and program reach.
* Support affiliates through implementation, scaling, and resource development.
* Measure program outcomes and present impact to leadership and stakeholders.

Coordinate conferences, educational events, and strategic partner engagement.  
* 
**Education Requirements**
--------------------------


Bachelor's degree in education, public health, healthcare administration, business administration, communications, marketing, or a related field required. Master's degree preferred.

**Technical Skills and Competencies**
-------------------------------------

* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams).
* Experience with Zoom, Microsoft Teams, webinar platforms, and Learning Management Systems.
* Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and public speaking skills.

Demonstrated initiative, sound judgment, adaptability, and ability to work independently.  
* 
**Supervisory Responsibilities**
--------------------------------


This position has no supervisory responsibilities.  

* 

**Work Environment and Travel**
-------------------------------

* Full\-time (35 hours/week), remote. Occasional early morning or evening sessions based on training needs. Travel approximately 4–6 times annually for conferences, trainings, meetings, and events.

jobs.title: Compliance & Sustainability Intelligence Manager (EPR)
jobs.description:
**About the company**



Founded in 2017, rePurpose Global is the leading Packaging Sustainability \& Compliance platform for consumer companies. We enable brands to measure their plastic footprint, recover plastic waste from nature through a global partner network, and streamline compliance across 45\+ packaging regulations — all from one platform.



rePurpose has recovered over 100 million pounds of plastic waste, supported 2,300\+ waste workers, and maintains 12 active impact projects worldwide. Our platform helps brands achieve compliance outcomes through advanced data management and regulatory expertise.



Headquartered in New York. Learn more at repurpose.global.



### **About the Role**



rePurpose Global helps consumer brands meet their Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) obligations for packaging across a fast\-growing set of U.S. and Canadian jurisdictions. Packaging EPR is now live in a growing number of U.S. states — each with its own producer definitions, fee structures, reporting categories, and deadlines — and the pace of change is only accelerating. Producers count on us to help them navigate this complexity with confidence, which relies on experts who grasp dense regulatory text and turn it into simple, actionable direction.



As a Compliance \& Sustainability Intelligence Manager, you'll own the outward\-facing side of that work: tracking regulatory change as it happens, educating customers and prospects, and translating dense statutory and program requirements into guidance producers can act on with confidence. This position carries the broadest go\-to\-market workload on the team, with a primary focus on the U.S. regulatory landscape. It's a highly visible role — you'll be one of the main faces of rePurpose Global's regulatory and compliance expertise to the market.



A defining part of the job is our webinar program, which you'll own end to end: shaping the topic and narrative, building the content, presenting live to audiences of producers, and fielding the technical and regulatory questions that follow. Between webinars, you'll answer the steady stream of customer and prospect questions that come with a shifting regulatory environment, produce written regulatory intelligence and market education, and equip our sales and customer teams with the talking points and materials they need. You'll work closely with our technical, product, and customer success teams, feeding market insight back into the product and flagging changes that affect how packaging is classified and reported.



### **This position is remote, but we prefer candidates located in New York or on the East Coast.**


### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Track U.S. regulatory change and turn it into intelligence.** Monitor enacted and emerging state programs, their reporting cycles, rulemaking activity, PRO program plans, administrative guidance, and enforcement timelines — and distill what's changing into guidance the team and customers can use.
* **Be a trusted first point of contact for regulatory questions.** Field customer and prospect questions on EPR obligations, fees, reporting categories, exemptions, and deadlines with empathy and clarity, converting dense rules into plain\-language, service\-oriented guidance that builds producer confidence and establishes audit\-ready documentation.
* **Own the webinar \& thought leadership program.** Plan the calendar and topics, build the content and narrative, host live sessions for producer audiences, and lead the follow\-up Q\&A — treating webinars as a core, recurring pillar of our market education and audience growth.
* **Create education and enablement content.** Write regulatory briefs, policy gap assessments, regulatory updates, blog posts, FAQs, explainers, and one\-pagers, and build the talking points and materials that equip the sales, marketing, and customer success teams to speak accurately and authoritatively about EPR.
* **Carry the market presence.** Represent rePurpose Global in public\-facing settings — producer education, industry engagement, comment\-period and rulemaking awareness — and stay close to how regulators, PROs, and producers are interpreting the rules.
* **Close the loop with the technical and product teams.** Flag regulatory changes that affect packaging classification, fees, or reporting so they can be reflected in our compliance software and product roadmap, and bring recurring customer questions back as input that shapes the platform experience.
### **Requirements**


* **A relevant foundation.** A background in EPR, packaging or environmental policy, sustainability, regulatory affairs, or a related field — built in industry, at a PRO or consultancy, or through study in environmental science, public policy, law, or packaging.
* **Deep EPR / packaging\-policy expertise.** Experience in plastics and packaging policy, circular economy, waste management, or Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR), with a working command of how these programs actually operate — governance, financing, PRO structures, and enforcement.
* **Regulatory fluency and range.** Ability to independently read, interpret, and track statutory and program text across multiple jurisdictions, and to hold the differences between them accurately rather than generalizing, with the range to run scenario modeling that shows producers how differing rules affect their portfolios.
* **Exceptional communication and presentation skills.** Genuine comfort speaking publicly and hosting webinars and live Q\&A, plus strong writing for a non\-expert audience — you can make a complex rule feel simple without losing what matters.
* **Customer\- and stakeholder\-facing polish.** Confidence in engaging producers, prospects, regulators, and industry groups, and the judgment to know how much detail each audience needs.
* **Comfort with ambiguity and pace.** The ability to stay organized and credible in a fast\-moving regulatory environment where guidance is often incomplete, a

ICMA is a mission\-driven nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing professional local government. Founded in 1914, ICMA is the leading professional association for local government leaders, managers, staff, and stakeholders – serving more than 14,000 members across the globe. As a membership association, we equip professionals with the research, knowledge, and tools needed to create and sustain thriving communities.

jobs.title: Sales Ops Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Project Manager of Revenue Operations plays a lead role responsible for driving sales performance, operational efficiency, and scalability within Bloomberg Industry Group. This role bridges the gap between the sales team and broader commercial functions, ensuring alignment with overall business strategies, market opportunities, and customer needs.
  

This individual will lead the coordination efforts within the RevOps functions including the Sales Operations, Data and Analytics, and Commercial Operations teams, as well as collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, IT, and other commercial teams to ensure seamless execution of sales processes, maximize revenue, and support the organization’s continued growth. This role will report to our Head of Revenue Operations out of our Arlington, VA office.**What you will do:**
---------------------

* Provide senior\-level leadership for complex, cross\-functional revenue initiatives that drive growth, improve pipeline performance, enhance customer experience, and delivery measurable financial outcomes.
* Own and govern large\-scale, high\-impact programs across the Revenue organization, ensuring alignment with revenue strategy, commercial priorities, and enterprise objectives.
* Establish and enforce standardized, scalable revenue workflows and delivery frameworks, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and opportunities to accelerate execution and adoption.
* Direct all aspects of project delivery, including scope, timelines, resourcing, budgets, risk mitigation, and change management, while anticipating and resolving issues before they impact revenue results.
* Serve as a strategic partner to the Revenue Leadership team and executive stakeholders, providing clear communication, data\-driven insights, and recommendations to support decision\-making.
* Lead the development of comprehensive business cases, value propositions, and investment justifications that quantify revenue impact, efficiency gains, and return on investment.
* Oversee business process assessments and guide cross\-functional teams to ensure initiatives and designed for scalability and align with long\-term revenue goals.
* Influence and align stakeholders across Product, Finance, Engineering, HR and Legal to delivery integrated solutions that support revenue growth and operational excellence
* Mentor and provide guidance to project managers, promoting best practices in project governance, execution discipline, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and report on key performance indicators to track progress, adoption, and execution.


You need to have:

* College degree with coursework in information systems, business, engineering, or equivalent experience is preferred. Formal training in project management strongly preferred.
* Minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in information systems, including three years of experience managing mid\-sized projects required. Experience in Consulting highly preferred.

**Compensation Range:**


$100,000\.00\-$125,000\.00  

Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process. Salary determination will be determined based on factors including but not limited to relevant experience, demonstrated skills related to the requirements of the role, education, certifications, and geographic location.

 **Equal Opportunity**

  

Bloomberg Industry Group maintains a continuing policy of non\-discrimination in employment. It is Bloomberg Industry Group’s policy to provide equal opportunity and access for all persons, and the Company is committed to attracting, retaining, developing, and promoting the most qualified individuals without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender identity or expression, genetic predisposition or carrier status, marital status, national or ethnic origin, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, parental or caring status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy or maternity/parental leave, protected veteran status, status as a victim of domestic violence, or any other classification protected by applicable law (“Protected Characteristic”). Bloomberg prohibits treating applicants or employees less favorably in connection with the terms and conditions of employment, in all phases of the employment process, because of one or more Protected Characteristics (“Discrimination”).

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Quality, GES NA Quality (Design & Construction)
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


You are a Senior Program Manager within the Design \& Construction (D\&C) Quality Management Team (QMT), part of Global Engineering Services (GES) North America. In this role, you serve as a senior quality program leader, autonomously driving the strategy, development, and execution of quality management programs that span the full D\&C project lifecycle across Amazon's logistics network.  

  

You independently own and deliver complex, cross\-functional quality programs—from Quality Management System (QMS) implementation to continuous improvement initiatives—with limited oversight. You operate as a trusted advisor to D\&C Execution Teams and Regional Leadership, providing strategic guidance on quality frameworks, process optimization, and data\-driven decision\-making. Your work directly influences how Amazon delivers construction projects at scale.  

  

Your work is approximately 60% tactical and 40% strategic. You develop program roadmaps, lead cross\-functional initiatives, make trade\-off decisions, and drive organizational alignment across multiple stakeholder groups. You are expected to influence without authority, navigate complex organizational dynamics, and deliver measurable business outcomes through quality programs.  

  

You bring deep expertise in program management, quality systems, and continuous improvement methodologies. You contribute to team strategy, and represent the QMT in senior leadership forums. You are a systems thinker who connects quality outcomes to business value and champions a culture where quality is everyone's job.  

  

This role requires strong executive communication skills, the ability to present complex decisions and trade\-offs to Directors and VPs, and a track record of building scalable programs in matrixed organizations.  

  

This position requires approximately 60% travel within North America to support field quality programs, stakeholder engagement, and program governance. You must be available to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Quality Assurance \& Compliance  

* Define quality standards, acceptance criteria, and compliance frameworks aligned with Amazon's D\&C standards
* Lead quality program governance including audit strategy, inspection protocols, and corrective action frameworks
* Autonomously own and deliver complex quality programs end\-to\-end with limited oversight, making trade\-off decisions independently
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives spanning Process Standards, Program Controls, Lifecycle

  

Business Impact and Value  

* Define success metrics and KPIs; monitor performance and drive corrective actions
* Manage program interdependencies, risks, and resource allocation across concurrent initiatives
* Lead development and alignment of process standards across all Miles within GES
* Establish governance mechanisms to ensure process adherence, measure effectiveness, and drive continuous refinement

  

Stakeholder Management \& Collaboration  

* Lead cross\-functional alignment across Preconstruction, Construction, Design, and external partners
* Influence without authority to drive quality adoption and behavioral change across the organization

  

Communication \& Reporting  

* Create executive\-level dashboards, reports, and narratives that connect quality outcomes to business value
* Translate complex quality data into compelling stories that drive organizational action

  

Process Improvement, Best Practices \& People Development  

* Identify and drive systemic improvements that eliminate waste, reduce defects, and accelerate delivery across the D\&C lifecycle
* Develop best practice frameworks, playbooks, and toolkits that enable consistent quality delivery at scale

  

A day in the life  

As a Senior Program Manager on the QMT, you are a strategic program leader who drives quality outcomes at scale. Your work is approximately 60% tactical and 40% strategic. A typical day might include:  

* Leading a cross\-functional governance review on implementation progress across Miles
* Presenting quality program performance and strategic recommendations
* Analyzing program data to identify systemic quality trends and developing improvement proposals
* Facilitating alignment between D\&C Execution Teams and partner organizations on process standards
* Driving improvement cycle from root cause analysis through solution implementation
* Participating in a QMT strategy session to shape the team's long\-term roadmap

  

About the team  

Global Engineering Services (GES) North America Design \& Construction is a diverse, collaborative team committed to delivering Amazon's logistics infrastructure with the highest standards of safety, quality, and sustainability. The Quality Management Team provides comprehensive quality assurance and control services to D\&C Execution Teams throughout North America, ensuring consistent project delivery from initial design through warranty walk. We believe quality is everyone's job and operate under four governance tenets: Simplify to Scale, Build Trust Through Transparency, Think Big Start Small, and Quality is Everyone's Job.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Knowledge of general AI tools
* Experience designing, implementing, and scaling

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**  
Kenney Business Solutions, Inc. is a minority owned government contracting firm based out of the Washington D.C. area. We have over 10 years of experience specializing in Records Management, FOIA Processing, Document Digitization, Legal Support, Program and Project Management support for multiple federal agencies. We are committed to delivering mission\-critical administrative solutions and supporting our clients with experienced, professional staff.

**POSITION TITLE**: Program Manager  
**Location:** Full\-Time On\-Site at USDA\-OGC Headquarters in Washington DC  
**BENEFITS:** Full  
**CLEARANCE REQUIRED**: OPM Public Trust T2S required. NACI through USDA HRMO must be completed before permanent badge issuance  
**US. Citizenship Required:** Yes \- US citizenship verification required.  
**SALARY BASE:** $150,000 a year \- Based on years of experience, required and preferred quals, team capabilities, and proposal ceilings.

**SUMMARY**

Kenney Business Solutions (KBS) is seeking an experienced **Program Manager** as part of an active proposal to lead a large\-scale Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) program supporting the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA). This is a senior leadership position responsible for the overall management, performance, staffing, quality control, and successful delivery of FOIA and records management services across multiple USDA component agencies.

The Program Manager will serve as the primary point of accountability between KBS and Government leadership, including the Contracting Officer, Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR), Department FOIA Officer, and component agency stakeholders. The successful candidate will combine strong program management experience with substantial knowledge of FOIA law, regulations, policy, and federal records management.

**RESPONSIBILTY OVERVIEW**

* Provide overall leadership and day\-to\-day management of the USDA FOIA program.
* Manage and oversee a team of approximately 15–20 FOIA and records management professionals.
* Develop and maintain project plans, performance measures, quality control procedures, staffing plans, and contract deliverables.
* Monitor program performance and ensure established quality and service standards are consistently achieved.
* Advise Government leadership regarding FOIA statutory, regulatory, and policy requirements.
* Manage staffing, recruitment, employee performance, and workforce continuity.
* Serve as the executive escalation point for USDA component customers and lead performance reviews and corrective actions.
* Oversee complex and high\-volume FOIA requests and ensure appropriate legal and procedural standards are followed.
* Compile, analyze, and report program performance and statistical data.
* Ensure timely and accurate completion of all required contract reports and deliverables.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop and maintain the Project Plan encompassing all tasks, using project management and FOIA expertise, and implement methods to measure FOIA performance and results
* Develop, submit, and maintain the Quality Control Plan within 10 calendar days of award, obtain Government acceptance within 30 calendar days, and own the inspection regime behind every Acceptable Quality Level.
* Advise Government management on FOIA legislative and regulatory requirements, including the 2016 FOIA Amendments, DOJ Office of Information Policy guidance, and USDA FOIA regulations.
* Serve as the designated leader who accepts tasking from Government points of contact, preserving the non\-personal services character of the work.
* Own all contract deliverables: kick\-off meeting within 10 business days of award, OCI certification within 15 days, and the Monthly Cumulative BPA Call Order Report by the 10th calendar day of each month.
* Manage and maintain staffing standard of 30 calendar days for new positions and 20 calendar days for replacements, obtaining CO approval for any exception, and maintain a qualified bench to meet it.
* Serve as the executive escalation point for all nine USDA component customers, chair performance reviews, and drive corrective action when any objective falls below its AQL.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Juris Doctor (JD) from an ABA\-accredited law school.**
* **Active admission to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.**
* **Minimum 8 years of professional experience.**
* **Minimum 3 years of direct experience managing a 15–20 person FOIA and/or Records Management program.**
* **Demonstrated knowledge of FOIA laws, regulations, legal precedent, case law, and federal FOIA processing requirements.**
* **Proficiency with Westlaw and PACER.**
* **Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Adobe Acrobat Pro.**
* **Strong analytical skills and experience managing complex or high\-volume FOIA requests.**
* **Exceptional written and verbal communication, organizational, case management, and time management skills.**
* **U.S. citizenship required.**
* **Ability to obtain and maintain an OPM Public Trust T2S clearance.**

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience managing a Department\-level or enterprise\-wide FOIA program supporting multiple component agencies.
* Experience with FOIAXpress, including the eCase Electronic Document Review module.
* Previous USDA experience or experience supporting a cabinet\-level agency Office of General Counsel.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience preparing Chief FOIA Officer Reports and DOJ OIP Annual FOIA Reports.
* Experience supporting FOIA litigation, including preparation of Vaughn Indices and declarations.

As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**



**Intelligence Analyst**

  




**About M1 Global**



Since 1994, M1 Global has grown from a local security provider to the trusted security partner of Fortune 500 companies worldwide. We build security programs for complex enterprise environments — from loading docks to data centers, headquarters to event venues — powered by Aurix™, our proprietary automation platform. We are part of the Specialized family of brands.



**Protecting the companies that power the world.**

**The Role**



The Intelligence Analyst is the senior analytical seat in the operation. You monitor an all\-hazards picture for client critical infrastructure across multiple sites in a disperse geographical areas severe weather, grid and utility disruption, civil unrest and protest activity, crime and targeted violence, unauthorized drone activity, transportation and supply disruption, wildfire, seismic activity, and public health events. You calculate what each event actually threatens, and you communicate that judgment to the people who act on it.



**Key Responsibilities**



**All\-Hazards Monitoring**



* Monitor a defined portfolio of sites continuously for natural, technological, human\-caused, and geopolitical hazards.



* Run open\-source intelligence collection across news, government, utility, meteorological, transportation, and social sources — and verify before you report.



* Maintain persistent awareness of regional conditions surrounding each assigned site, including power and water availability, road and airspace status, and local civil activity.



* Track developing situations through resolution and update stakeholders as the picture changes.



**Risk Calculation and Assessment**



* Assess every event against three factors — proximity to the site, severity of the hazard, and incident or risk type — and produce a defensible risk determination from them.



* Apply the program’s scoring and threshold criteria consistently, so the same event produces the same call regardless of who is on shift.



* Distinguish credible threats from noise. Explain the reasoning behind each call, not just the conclusion.



* Identify second\-order effects: what a hazard disrupts downstream, and which sites inherit the consequence.



* Recommend threshold and criteria adjustments to leadership when event patterns show the current settings are miscalibrated.



**Stakeholder Communication and Escalation**



* Notify the right stakeholders at the right time, matched to proximity, severity, and risk type — site leadership, regional leadership, operations, and client security leadership.



* Write and deliver alerts that state the hazard, the affected site, the assessed impact, and the recommended action. Bottom line first.



* Escalate through defined paths without delay, and confirm receipt on time\-critical notifications.



* Serve as the analytical voice during crisis coordination — give leadership the picture they need to decide, in the time they have to decide it.



* Brief technical and non\-technical audiences with the same clarity.



**Intelligence Production and Reporting**



* Produce daily intelligence briefs covering the previous 24 hours and the day ahead, written for site and regional leads.



* Produce weekly summaries with emerging indicators and a forward outlook.



* Answer requests for information with sourced, analyst\-produced assessments inside agreed turnaround times.



* Build trend analysis that identifies recurring risk exposure across the portfolio and informs mitigation planning.



* Document every assessment so it holds up on later review.



**Program Support**



* Support drills, tabletop exercises, and after\-action reviews.



* Contribute to standard operating procedures, escalation matrices, and notification templates — and keep them current as conditions change.



* Work inside client systems, procedures, and reporting standards. One process, not a second one to reconcile.



**Required Qualifications**



* Five or more years of intelligence analysis, threat monitoring, or security operations experience — or equivalent practical experience.



* Bachelor’s degree in intelligence studies, international relations, emergency management, criminal justice, geography, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.



* Demonstrated background in one or more of: military or government intelligence, law enforcement, corporate security, or emergency management.



* Working command of structured analytic techniques and cognitive bias mitigation.



* Open\-source intelligence tradecraft, including source verification and digital hygiene.



* Proven written clarity under time pressure. Bottom\-line\-up\-front writing built for executive decisions.



* Experience assessing risk by proximity, severity, and hazard type, and escalating on defined criteria.



* Proficiency with commercial intelligence and event\-monitoring platforms, geospatial and mapping tools, mass notification systems, and case management platforms.



* Availability for any shift in a 24/7/365 operation, including nights, weekends, and holidays.



* Ability to pass all pre\-employment screening and meet local licensing requirements.



**Preferred Qualifications**



* Experience supporting data centers, critical infrastructure, or a multi\-site enterprise portfolio.



* Experience in multi\-national operations.



* Experience building or tuning risk scoring models, alert thresholds, or geofenced monitoring criteria.



* Crisis management or emergency operations center experience.



* Industry certification — ASIS CPP or PSP, ATAP Certified Threat Manager, GIAC Open Source Intelligence (GOSI), FEMA Professional Development Series, or equivalent.



* Experience mentoring or training analysts.

**All\-Hazards Analysis**  


**Risk Calculation**  


**Stakeholder Communication**  


**OSINT Tradecraft**

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Amazon Cyber Threat Intelligence
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


As a Senior Technical Program Manager in the Amazon Cyber Threat Intelligence organization, you will be a critical part of an organization focused on influencing the security culture within Amazon. Amazon Cyber Threat Intelligence is responsible for understanding threat actors and how their techniques are being used against Amazon’s businesses. You will support and enhance the daily operations of our program by identifying, planning, and executing strategic improvement projects spanning multiple teams. You will apply your knowledge of project management and the threat intelligence lifecycle to deliver automation efforts that scale intelligence for Amazon, coordinate intelligence sharing across teams, and implement improvements and efficiencies across the organization. You will identify future opportunities for improvement through implementing and analyzing quantitative metrics around program functions. You will help the team develop repeatable processes that improve program capabilities and project execution. You will be a crucial element for both our threat intelligence team and for larger intelligence priorities across Amazon ensuring the continued safety and security of our customers.
  

  

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

The successful candidate will work as a leader in a team of talented security professionals. You will be responsible for program management across ACTI's customer experience initiatives, data governance, metrics and reporting, and the operational rhythm of business activities. You will own the customer feedback cycle, coordinate cross\-team goals and priorities, and ensure that analyst requirements are effectively translated into actionable engineering roadmap items. You will have a strong mix of program management expertise, customer obsession, security fundamentals, and experience working with intelligence or security operations teams. We are looking for TPMs who excel at solving ambiguous problems, removing obstacles, and driving alignment across diverse stakeholders. You will design and implement processes, drive metrics\-based improvements, and work with analysts, engineers, and customer teams to develop innovative solutions to complex organizational challenges. You will be able to prioritize well, communicate clearly, and have a consistent track record of delivery. You are proactive in removing roadblocks and can handle multiple competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment. You will influence diverse teams, effectively rally support for your initiatives, and help technical and analytical teams create simple solutions to meet customer goals. You can handle business escalations with a data\-driven approach to build trust with analysts, engineers, and senior leaders.
  

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why Amazon Security?  

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.  

  

Training \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, training, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* 5\+ years of analytical, quantitative, communication, and presentations experience
* 2\+ years of IT Security experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of IT Security experience
* Experience developing and executing/delivering product and technical roadmaps influencing internal and external stakeholders
* Experience running user trials, beta, field testing or collecting customer feedback
* 5\+ years of working directly with security operations, intelligence analysis, or customer\-facing security teams
* Experience with Cyber Threat Intelligence operations or platforms
* Experience with data governance, data modeling, or data quality initiatives

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

We are serious about technology, we dream big, and we execute: Capital One moved our entire enterprise to the public cloud over the course of five years. Just as we prioritize driving innovation through technology, we equally prioritize cybersecurity, reliability, software quality, and data management.

**Overview**


Technomics is a growing employee\-owned, decision analytics company that provides professional services and management solutions to help our clients make ***better decisions faster***. We enable a wide range of clients across the Federal government, from senior level policy makers to program managers, to ***choose smartly, buy effectively and operate efficiently****.* We deliver practical, credible and defensible results offering actionable insights by applying data\-driven and analytics\-based approaches in combination with multidisciplinary talent, subject matter expertise, and tangible and repeatable assets in the form of databases, models, approaches and techniques.  

  

Analysts have the knowledge, skills, abilities and initiative to deliver timely, practical and innovative solutions to our clients as part of high\-performing project teams typically composed of a mix of junior and mid\-level analysts.


Our employee\-owners pride themselves on their ability to apply deep analytical rigor and innovative thought that assist clients in understanding and solving a myriad of challenging resource planning and management problems.


This position may be located in Arlington, VA (Headquarters), Washington D.C., Pentagon, Springfield, VA., Chantilly, VA., Tysons Corner, VA.  

  

**Position\-Specific Overview**  

Data Analysts will support a U.S. Government client in developing data\-driven solutions using Palantir Foundry and related technologies. The role will support data integration, transformation, analytics, and user\-facing applications that improve access to mission and business information.


The individual will work with technical teams and end users to develop data pipelines, analytical workflows, and applications, translate requirements into practical solutions, and support testing and implementation. Direct Palantir Foundry experience is preferred but not required.

* Develop, maintain, and improve data pipelines, transformations, analytical workflows, and user\-facing data products in Palantir Foundry and related technologies.

* Support data modeling, database design, testing, documentation, and deployment of new capabilities.

* Experience with low\-code application development, cloud technologies, or UX/UI design.

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with Palantir Foundry or comparable data and analytics platforms.

jobs.title: Sr. Business Analyst (Commercial FRM)
jobs.description:
As the digital arm for the world's largest food and beverage company, Nestlé IT \& Digital Americas harnesses the power of data, analytics, and innovative technology to deliver transformative solutions and business resiliency for Nestlé businesses and iconic brands from Purina® to Nescafé®. We’re innovators, strategic collaborators, value multipliers, and digital business leaders committed to delivering results that create meaningful experiences and drive value, enabling Nestlé to win in the marketplace. By joining, you become part of a 150\-year legacy and a global team of 270,000\+. We invest in our people—their growth, development, and sense of belonging. This shared unity and purpose is what motivates individuals to join, stay, and advance their careers within Nestlé.

 *This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.*

 **Position Summary**

  

The Functional Relationship Management (FRM) team serves as the critical link between Nestlé Digital \& IT and the Commercial business, helping shape how technology capabilities are prioritized, funded, and delivered across Nestlé USA. As a Senior Business Analyst, you’ll be a key operational partner to the Commercial FRM function, driving alignment, execution, and business outcomes across a complex portfolio. Working closely with senior leaders, you will help define priorities, manage plans, oversee financial and portfolio performance, while translating complex information into clear, actionable insights that enable disciplined decision\-making and successful execution.

  

* Manage the daily operations of the Commercial FRM function, ensuring priorities, initiatives, milestones, risks, and dependencies are tracked and communicated to provide leadership with clear visibility into progress and performance
* Develop high\-quality, executive\-ready materials that communicate portfolio progress, priorities, and recommendations with clarity and impact
* Own financial tracking for the Commercial portfolio, including budget management, forecasting, variance analysis, and reconciliation of actuals
* Support the Sr. Director of FRM in driving alignment, preparing for key forums, and managing communications across stakeholders
* Ensure leadership interactions are well\-prepared, focused, and result in clear actions
* Facilitate alignment and ensure follow\-through on key actions and commitments across Commercial, Digital \& IT, and other stakeholders
* Identify opportunities to improve how the FRM function operates by refining processes, templates, and tools that enhance efficiency, consistency, and overall impact

 **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree
* 7\+ years of experience in business operations, portfolio management, strategy support, and/or a related role within a large, complex organization

 **Other**

* 1 \+ years of experience managing budgets, forecasting, and/or analyzing financial performance is preferred
* Experience with Commercial, Sales, or Marketing functions is preferred
* Experience in Consumer Product Goods (CPG) and/or a similarly complex industry is preferred

  

The approximate pay range for this position is $89,630\.00 to $126,980\.00\. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to background, knowledge, skills, and abilities as well as geographic location of the position. Nestlé offers performance\-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with Company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at About Us \| Making an Impact \| Nestle Careers (nestlejobs.com).

  

It is our business imperative to remain a very inclusive workplace.  

  

To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. The skills you've gained while serving our country, such as flexibility, agility, and leadership, are much like the skills that will make you successful in this role. In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities. Nestlé seeks such skilled and qualified individuals to share our mission where you’ll join a cohort of others who have chosen to call Nestlé home.

  

The Nestlé Companies are equal employment opportunity employers. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Prior to the next step in the recruiting process, we welcome you to inform us confidentially if you may require any special accommodations in order to participate fully in our recruitment experience. Contact us at accommodations@nestle.com or please dial 711 and provide this number to the operator: 1\-800\-321\-6467\.

jobs.description:
**Senior Information Security Analyst**
=======================================

﻿  

  

**Category**
------------


Information Technology

Washington, District of Columbia  

  

**Tracking Code**
-----------------


5468

-----------------


Full\-Time/Regular  

  

CALIBRE Systems, Inc., an employee\-owned mission focused solutions and digital transformation company, is looking for a highly qualified Senior Information Security Analyst to support a DoD client with enterprise cybersecurity for a large program serving military families. This position will be hybrid with some required meetings in Alexandria, VA.



This candidate will lead and oversee cybersecurity compliance, security architecture, threat detection, vulnerability management, incident response, RMF/eMASS support, and ATO sustainment for DoD cloud infrastructure and information systems. The senior analyst will provide technical leadership for Zero Trust Architecture implementation, advanced security monitoring, vulnerability remediation, cyber reporting, and coordination with Government cybersecurity stakeholders.


**An active Secret clearance is required.**


**Salary range will be from $105k\-$115k.**

**Key Responsibilities:**


* Lead RMF, ATO, continuous monitoring, and eMASS activities, including development and execution of ATO action plans and sustainment documentation.


* Develop and maintain Zero Trust Architecture across IL2, IL4, and IL5 cloud infrastructure and prepare quarterly Zero Trust compliance briefings.


* Design and implement advanced security architectures for predictive threat detection, incident response, real\-time security insights, and cloud infrastructure resilience.


* Oversee weekly DISA STIG/SRG and ACAS assessments, vulnerability prioritization, remediation planning, and integration of results into eMASS.


* Lead POA\&M governance, evidence collection, mitigation planning, and validation coordination with ISSM, ISSO, SCA Team, CIO/AO, and other Government stakeholders.


* Direct monitoring and analysis of cyber resources, SIEM\-integrated logs, WAF/NGFW activity, anomaly detection, account aging, compliance monitoring, insider threat indicators, and GovCloud logs.


* Provide rapid escalation and advisory support for abnormal findings, vulnerabilities, cyber threats, OPORDs, CTOs, WARNORDs, and secure incident communications.


* Lead vulnerability assessments and penetration testing for new or modified applications, servers, databases, and infrastructure components before deployment.


* Coordinate with the Tier 2 Cybersecurity Service Provider to support incident lifecycle management, response coordination, and reporting timelines.


* Develop, recommend, and implement automated incident response workflows, cybersecurity playbooks, threat simulation labs, and cross\-agency exercise scenarios.


* Oversee recurring audits of cybersecurity SOPs, contingency planning, disaster recovery exercises, and reporting through the IT, Cybersecurity, and Data Operations Dashboard.


* Access SIPRNet and attend classified briefings at the Government facility in Alexandria, Virginia, as required.
  


  

**Required Skills**
-------------------


* Advanced knowledge of NIST RMF, eMASS, DISA STIGs/SRGs, ACAS, POA\&Ms, DoD Zero Trust requirements, DoD 8140/DCWF mandates, and cybersecurity reporting requirements.


* Ability to analyze threat, vulnerability, compliance, and security monitoring data and translate findings into actionable remediation plans and executive\-level reporting.


* Coordination with ISSMs, ISSOs, SCA teams, CIO/AO stakeholders, CSSPs, and technical operations teams.


* Ability to develop cybersecurity policies, SOPs, automated workflows, incident response playbooks, or security architecture recommendations.


**Desired Skills and Qualifications:**


* Master’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a related field.


* DoD 8570/8140\-aligned certification such as Security\+ CE, CySA\+, CISSP, CASP\+, or equivalent


* Active Top Secret clearance


* Experience with eMASS or other compliance tracking platforms.


* Proficiency with cloud security controls and cloud\-based compliance requirements.


* Demonstrable knowledge of Zero Trust principles and cybersecurity modernization strategies.
  


  

**Required Experience**
-----------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a related field.


* Active Secret security clearance.


* **7\+ years** of experience in cybersecurity, RMF support, compliance, or information assurance.


* Senior\-level experience (e.g. leading, mentoring, or supervising others) with DoD cybersecurity, information assurance, RMF, ATO, vulnerability management, compliance, or incident response activities.
  


  

**CALIBRE and its subsidiaries are an Equal Opportunity Employer and supports transitioning service members, veterans and individuals with disabilities. We offer a competitive salary and full benefits package. To be considered, please apply via our website at** **www.calibresys.com****. Come join our dynamic team. \#CALIBRECareers**

jobs.description:
Overview:
**Mission Business Analyst**  

**Arlington, VA**  

Are you ready to enhance your skills and build your career in a rapidly evolving business climate? Are you looking for a career where professional development is embedded in your employer’s core culture? If so, Chenega Military, Intelligence \& Operations Support (MIOS) could be the place for you! Join our team of professionals who support large\-scale government operations by leveraging cutting\-edge technology and take your career to the next level!  

SecuriGence is seeking a **Mission Business Analyst** with communication and writing abilities to support complex technological innovation throughout the agency. In this position, you will work with technical development programs on behalf of the information technology directorate to ensure that all IT support is not only met, but exceeded, to enable the development of the most innovative technology in the country. In this fast\-paced environment, you will not only require technical comprehension, but agile process and development understanding, and an ability to work with all personalities, including engineers, developers, cybersecurity experts, elite academics, active\-duty military, and more. Attention to detail, flexibility, and self\-motivation are also keys to success in this role.
Responsibilities:
* Serve as the main customer liaison from ITD to the Technical Office (TO). Complement TO SCA, PSO/PSR, and VIP Analyst to form a coherent Support Office team for DARPA Programs and PMs.
* Create and manage projects from DARPA Programs to enable the missions, including RMB/II cases, engineering tasks, and other domains within ITD. Coordinate product delivery across ITD, MSO, and external teams as required.
* Maintain a thorough knowledge of TO portfolio and ITD’s impact on Programs. Prospectively identify possible delays to milestones and communicate with Tech SETA and PM teams on pain points and needed capabilities.
* Analyze and respond to Program Support Strategy (PSS) requests and meetings, and interface with ITD as required for Appendix generation. Attend PSS review meetings for all PIPs, and complete ITD requirements.
* Curate a broad and deep knowledge base on all ITD services and systems. Field requests for information and process from TO personnel up through Office leadership, both in person and on\-network.
* Build and maintain positive relationships within a context of power imbalances, often in contentious environments.
* Demonstrate accountability in situations where technical tasks and resource prioritization are outside your control; manage significant expectations from competing parties on tight deadlines.
* Attend Staff, SETA, and all other TO meetings as the sole ITD representative. Create and brief deliverables on active projects and operational priorities.
* Manage aging Help Desk, Operations, Security, and other ITD team requests as part of the escalation chain. Navigate inter\-team dynamics to assist the TO with resolving ITD issues as a priority without hierarchical or tasking authority.
* Report TO activities with ITD\-relevant aspects back to ITD on a regular and ad\-hoc basis. Mirror the TO role and act as the primary liaison from the office to ITD leadership, creating and updating various reporting systems.
* Work location and hours as required by TOs, including time zone impacts, for up to 24\-hour support.
* Other duties as assigned


Qualifications:
* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer science, engineering, business administration, communications, public relations, or related field.
* 3\+ years working as a Business Analyst or Product Owner with experience in large\-scale enterprise environments
	+ Experience in change management, organizational development, or related fields is a plus.
* Secret clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI
* Successfully pass background and drug screening

 **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:*** Business Analysis Expertise: Proven experience as a Business Analyst, demonstrating a strong understanding of business processes, data analysis, and financial modeling techniques.
* Lean Business Case Development: Familiarity with developing Lean Business Cases and best practices for quantifying value, assessing risk, and justifying investment decisions.
* Communication \& Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with stakeholders at all levels.
* Problem\-solving and Critical Thinking: Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to identify challenges, evaluate alternatives, and recommend effective solutions.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills, with the ability to build rapport, resolve conflicts, and drive consensus among stakeholders.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to assess complex situations, identify root causes, and develop pragmatic solutions to address them.
* Proficiency in Agile tools and techniques for project management, collaboration, and tracking (e.g., JIRA, Confluence) is desirable.
* Commitment to continuous learning, professional growth, and staying updated with the latest Agile trends and practices

 **How you’ll grow**
At Chenega MIOS, our professional development plan focuses on helping our team members at every level of their careers to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn.  

We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands\-on experience in the global, fast\-changing business world. From on\-the\-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their careers. **Benefits**

jobs.description:

SAIC has an opportunity for a Junior FAA Aviation Data Analyst. This role is remote and requires 10% travel.

**Responsibilities:**

* Reviews aviation\-related information to assist in decisions about flight routes, spending practices, employee efficiency, safety, aviation regulations (including national security) and other topics. Uses data to make predictions and give estimations related to all aspects of aviation.

**Qualifications**


**Required Education \& Experience:**

* Bachelors and 2\-5 years of related experience; Masters and 1 year or more experience
* Five years of relevant experience may be substituted for the Bachelor's Degree. Equivalent aviation data analyst experience in the U.S. Military or international control environment is acceptable.
* Proficiency in aviation data analysis tools and software (such as Tableau, Excel, or similar platforms).
* Strong understanding of FAA regulations, national security protocols, and industry best practices is highly preferred.
* Experience in developing and presenting technical briefings to stakeholders at various organizational levels.
* Ability to conduct Business Process Re\-engineering (BPR) and lead process improvement initiatives.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare technical documents and reports.
* Familiarity with systems engineering and operations research methodologies is a plus.

**Required Clearance:**

* US Citizenship.
* FAA Suitability: Ability to obtain and maintain FAA public trust and FAA resume approval.


Target salary range: $40,001 \- $80,000\. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

jobs.description:
**Geotechnical Research Technician (On‑Site)**

**Location:** Turner–Fairbank Highway Research Center, 6300 Georgetown Pike, McLean, VA

**Employer:** Advanced Global Resources (AGR), LLC.

**Position Type:** Full\-Time, **On\-Site** (no remote authorized)

**Hours of Operation:** Monday – Friday 8 hours shifts, 7:30 am – 4:00 pm

**Clearance:** Must meet TFHRC facility access requirements

  

Hiring immediate with start date within 2 weeks of passing federal background check

**About the Role**


Join a nationally recognized federal research center supporting geotechnical innovation that directly impacts U.S. transportation infrastructure. As a **Geotechnical Research Technician**, you will work hands‑on in the FHWA Geotechnical Laboratory, supporting research on soils, foundations, erosion, pavements, and geotechnical materials. You’ll assist engineers, set up and run experiments, install instrumentation, collect data, and help maintain a state‑of‑the‑art research facility.


This role is ideal for mechanically inclined, detail‑oriented individuals who enjoys research testing, technically inclines, data organizer experienced with spreadsheets, and contributing to meaningful national research.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Laboratory Testing \& Experiment Support**

* Set up, operate, and break down geotechnical experiments (triaxial, direct shear, resilient modulus, erosion testing, permeability, etc.)
* Prepare, mix, and fabricate soil specimens using sands, clays, gravels, and engineered materials.
* Install sensors, reference assemblies, and data acquisition systems for manual and automated readings.
* Conduct standardized geotechnical tests following ASTM and AASHTO procedures.
* Document procedures with clear notes, photos, and organized data.

**Instrumentation \& Field Support**

* Assist with field testing, instrumentation installation, and data collection at off‑site locations.
* Operate forklifts, cranes, and rigging equipment (training provided).
* Handle Shelby tube and other sensitive samples to minimize disturbance.

**Operations \& Maintenance (Engineering Lab)**

* Maintain laboratory cleanliness, organization, and equipment readiness.
* Support calibration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of lab equipment.
* Coordinate logistics, materials, and supplies for ongoing research activities.

**Research Support \& Data Management**

* Collect, organize, and analyze test data in approved formats.
* Assist engineers with experimental plans, schematics, and documentation.
* Contribute to high‑quality research outputs, including internal reports and technical notes.

 **Required Qualifications**

* Ability to pass a federal background check (no criminal record, pass drug test, either US citizen or non\-US citizen who has an authorization to work in the US and resided in the US for the last 3 years, valid drivers license.)
* Completion of **at least two years of technical training** in engineering technician skills, electronics, computer science, or related fields (GT‑RT‑1 requirement).
* Strong mechanical aptitude and ability to work with tools and laboratory equipment.
* Demonstrated hands‑on experience in a geotechnical laboratory.
* Knowledge of standard ASTM/AASHTO soil testing methods.
* Ability to lift 50 lbs and be on your feet for up to 8 hours per day.
* Strong communication skills and ability to follow detailed technical instructions.
* Comfortable working with formulas in spreadsheets

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree within the area of civil engineering or geology.
* Experience with large‑scale geotechnical testing (triaxial, direct shear, erosion function apparatus, interface shear).
* Familiarity with instrumentation systems and data acquisition hardware.
* Experience directing general laborers or assisting engineering staff.
* Data analysis skills and ability to prepare clear summaries of test results.
* Forklift or overhead crane experience (training can be provided).

jobs.title: Business Analyst 2
jobs.description:
We are seeking a forward\-thinking SharePoint Online Administrator who is highly skilled in designing, managing, and evolving enterprise SharePoint solutions to support NASA’s Office of Strategic Infrastructure and Center Operations Directorate. This role requires someone who can understand mission needs, translate requirements into effective digital solutions, and guide customers toward smarter, more efficient use of SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365\.

**\*On\-Site \- Must reside within 50 miles of a NASA Center.\***

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Meet regularly with customers, site owners, and mission teams to understand their day‑to‑day challenges and information management needs.
* Help translate business requirements into practical SharePoint solutions such as pages, lists, libraries, and basic workflows or forms.
* Improve site organization and searchability by setting up and maintaining site structures and document libraries. Use consistent metadata and simple taxonomy guidelines so users can easily find the information they need.
* Offer guidance on SharePoint features and recommend ways users can streamline their processes using built‑in capabilities.
* Assist with creating new business solutions using SharePoint Online, Power Automate, Power Apps, and other Microsoft 365 tools, focusing on configuration rather than custom development.
* Create and maintain site templates, list configurations, metadata setups, and basic term store entries to support organized and consistent content management.
* Support teams in making full use of SharePoint as a collaboration and information‑sharing platform.
* Manage site collections, permissions, storage settings, and basic configuration tasks across SharePoint Online.
* Apply security, compliance, and governance settings based on established organizational standards.
* Help oversee content lifecycle tasks such as archiving, maintaining clean version histories, and ensuring metadata is properly used.
* Troubleshoot common SharePoint issues including access problems, performance concerns, and configuration inconsistencies.
* Assist with site migrations, onboarding new SharePoint sites, and supporting cross‑team coordination around platform use.
* Review current SharePoint or Microsoft 365 setups and provide practical recommendations to improve usability, efficiency, and compliance with organizational guidelines.
* Build and maintain simple Power BI dashboards or reports to help teams view data and make informed decisions.
* Share progress on SharePoint improvements with leadership in clear, easy‑to‑understand terms.
* Proactively communicate risks, limitations, and opportunities to customers and stakeholders.

 **Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related field.
* 4\+ years’ experience with SharePoint Online, Power Platform, or M365 tools
* Support day‑to‑day management of SharePoint Online and M365 sites, including site collections, libraries, lists, permissions, and basic site structure.
* Improve data organization and ease of use by helping implement consistent folder structures, metadata, and simple retention practices.
* Working knowledge of SharePoint Online features and integration with Teams, OneDrive, and M365 Groups.
* Assist with monitoring storage usage, applying sharing settings, and following governance guidelines.
* Basic PowerShell experience for routine tasks such as bulk updates, permissions adjustments, and generating reports.
* Familiarity with Entra ID (Azure AD) concepts related to authentication and access control.
* Support the application of security settings, governance policies, retention labels, and proper access management.
* Understand versioning, recycle bin processes, and common recovery steps.
* General awareness of SharePoint performance basics and standard troubleshooting approaches.
* Experience using migration tools or supporting SharePoint data moves between cloud and on‑prem environments.
* Build simple workflows or automations using Power Platform tools like Power Automate
* Comfortable working with Teams, OneDrive, and Power Platform integrations; awareness of modern SharePoint features.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical steps in an easy‑to‑understand way.
* Solid problem‑solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Commitment to maintaining clean, organized sites that support user productivity.
* Customer‑focused mindset with proactive support habits.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting larger organizations, including government or federal environments.
* Participation in delivering SharePoint improvements or small solution initiatives.
* Experience collaborating across IT teams, business units, and leadership.
* Ability to create helpful dashboards, scripts, or simple automation tools (Power BI, PowerShell, Graph API, M365 admin tools).

**Additional Requirements**

* Must be located within **50 miles of a NASA Center**

**Clearance Requirement**

* Must be able to obtain and maintain a **Public Trust Clearance**

Concurrent Technologies Corporation (CTC) is seeking a qualified and proactive **Lead Program Analyst** to support federal capital investment and infrastructure initiatives within the Energy, Resilience and Sustainability (ERS) Division. This position will support programs that strengthen infrastructure resilience, energy security, mission readiness, and the long\-term sustainability of federal installations and assets.


The ERS Division is seeking a qualified and detail\-oriented **Lead Program Analyst** to provide analytical expertise and coordinated oversight for capital investment initiatives across Marine Corps Installations Command (MCICOM) Restoration \& Modernization (RM), Demolition, Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M), and Military Construction (MILCON) programs. The successful candidate will support enterprise\-level program execution by developing and maintaining program plans and guidance, tracking financial and execution actions, conducting detailed data analysis, coordinating governance activities, and delivering high‑quality reporting and documentation for senior leadership.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**


* Interfaces with Director of Capital Investments.
* Ensures all deliverables developed for Capital Investments branch comply with performance frameworks and quality assurance measures.
* Manages long\-range RM program planning and delivers regular execution updates.
* Oversee monitoring of current\-year RM, Demolition, O\&M, and MILCON program execution; track milestones and produce weekly/monthly status reports.
* Drafts, coordinates, and review official program documentation, including Authorities to Advertise, Congressional Notifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and guidance updates.
* Conducts comprehensive data analysis across RM, Demolition, O\&M, and MILCON portfolios; develop metrics, reports, and briefs for Government review.
* Coordinates governance activities, including planning and supporting Capital Investment Working Group (CIWG) meetings, preparing agendas, briefing materials, minutes, and After\-Action Reports.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high\-growth Series A start\-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin\-out, and our unique combination of learning\-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion\-dollar industry.



Gravis builds the RACK, our manufacturer\-agnostic hardware and software system that turns excavators and loaders into autonomous machines, alongside Slate, our platform for planning, perception, and machine intelligence.



### **About the role**



You will own end\-to\-end program delivery for one or more key initiatives at Gravis. Technical Program Managers sit at the intersection of strategic, commercial and customer requirements, and engineering execution on squads that draw from our functional teams.



We are looking for candidates with a background in technical program management, product management, or engineering management with solid experience structuring and delivering complex cross\-team programs from planning through commercial delivery.


### **What you will do**


**Program ownership**


* Own end\-to\-end program planning and reporting for major initiatives spanning software releases, hardware integration, and field validation, tracking milestones, dependencies, and risks across distributed teams.
* Translate high\-level strategic, commercial and product goals into structured plans, roadmaps, and quarterly commitments in partnership with engineering leads.
* Identify and resolve blockers before they hit the critical path.
* Coordinate software release processes, including integration testing, regression validation, and staged rollouts to field deployments.

**Collaboration \& reporting**


* Act as the operational interface with external partners: OEM integrators, construction contractors, and equipment rental providers, coordinating requirements and delivery schedules.
* Lead cross\-team alignment and program reviews, producing clear documentation (roadmaps, RACI matrices, status dashboards) for engineering, operations, and leadership.
* Gather structured feedback from field deployments and translate it into actionable input for engineering teams.
### **What we're looking for**



We recognise that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with varied combinations of skills. If you meet most but not all of the core qualifications below, we encourage you to apply.


**Core qualifications**


* 5–10 years of experience in technical program management, product management or engineering program management, or a closely related role, with a track record of delivering complex, multi\-team programs from planning through commercial delivery in a fast\-paced, deep\-tech environment.
* Solid technical foundation as evidenced by technical degree(s) in engineering or related fields.
* Hands\-on experience with agile / iterative development methodologies and tools such as Jira or Linear.
* Good working knowledge of software and hardware development practices, system architecture, and CI/CD or testing practices.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity, aggressive timelines, and cross\-functional collaboration across engineering, field, and commercial stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel as required by business projects.
* High proficiency in English with the ability to read, write and present technical materials clearly and concisely.

**Nice to have**


* Experience with robotics or hardware product development cycles and embedded systems.
* Exposure to safety\-critical or field\-deployed systems.
* Experience coordinating programs across multiple countries or regulatory environments.
* Prior experience at an early\-stage hardware/software startup.
### **This role is a great fit if…**


* You care about building things that directly impact the real world at scale and work reliably outside the lab, with imperfect data, real constraints, and genuine stakes.
* You want to help build the program management function at Gravis from the ground up, establishing practices that scale as the company grows.
* You thrive when bridging disciplines, moving fluidly between hardware, software, and field operations conversations in the same day.
* You value a collaborative culture built on thoughtful design, creative problem\-solving, mutual respect, and pragmatism.
This is an opportunity to join a dynamic, multidisciplinary team and to be part of a company that is reshaping heavy construction.



Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
